claim: A bare literal is decimal: YMAX EQU 240 — no trailing-period radix convention in RASM.
The !> operator takes the high byte / shifts: SETDP RAM!>8 sets the direct page from the RAM base.
The !. operator masks bits: LDB #LCOINV!.$FF masks the equate to a byte.
Macros take backslash-numbered params: NAPP MACRO \0,\1.
